description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is an Off-Road Heavy Duty Metal Door Handle Kit made for the Suzuki Samurai & SJ413.
Fits All Years
Interior Door Handle Color is GRAY / Exterior Door Handle Color is BLACK.
Lets you replace all those Weak Plastic Handles with Off-Road Grade Metal Handles.
You get the Exterior Door Handles, Interior Door Handles & Window Regulator Cranks for BOTH DOORS.
PLUS We Include the Pins for the Interior Handles and the Escutcheons for the Cranks!
Exterior handles may require spacers and slight modification. Spacers are included and go between door panel and handle frame.
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – METAL – Exterior Door Handles (LH & RH) – Color: Black
Qty 2 – METAL – Interior Door Handles (LH & RH) – Color: Dark Gray
Qty 2 – METAL – Pins for Interior Handles
Qty 2 – METAL – Window Crank Handles (LH & RH) – Color: Dark Gray
Qty 2 – METAL – Clips, Window Crank
Qty 2 – PLASTIC – Washers that go behind Window Cranks
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
